Veigar

the Tiny Master of Evil
Mid laneBot lane

Veigar is the tiny master of evil who grows stronger every minute. Every spell hit on a champion, every minion killed with Q and every takedown permanently increases his ability power, with no limit. His cage stuns, and his ultimate deletes anyone at low health. Perfect for patient players who love to scale.

When to pick Veigar

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not ideal. He's weak early and many mages out-range him, so picking him after the enemy mid is safer.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages who walk into his cage, like Azir and Galio
  • Melee mids and divers who must walk through Event Horizon, like Yasuo or Irelia
  • Slow, scaling games: the longer it goes, the bigger his AP stacks
  • Teams with squishy carries he can one-shot late

Avoid into

  • Assassins who kill him before he stacks, like Katarina and LeBlanc
  • Long-range poke that keeps him from farming, like Vel'Koz
  • Fast-paced, early-game teams that end before he scales

Great teammates

LeonaLeona's stuns hold targets inside Event Horizon so Dark Matter lands.
AmumuAmumu stuns enemies, giving Veigar a free cage and combo.
BraumBraum's shield and stuns keep divers off Veigar while he scales.

Your team needs: Pick Veigar when your team can survive the early game and protect him while he scales.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Endless scaling: he gains ability power forever
  • Event Horizon is a cage that stuns anyone who walks through its edge
  • Primordial Burst deals more damage the lower the target's health
  • One of the highest late-game burst threats in the game

Weaknesses

  • Weak early: he needs time to stack
  • No dash: easy target for divers
  • Dark Matter is slow and easy to dodge without a stun
  • Lots of champions out-range him in lane

Power spikes

  • Level 6: Primordial Burst gives you real kill threat.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): stronger burst and wave clear.
  • Two items (Stormsurge): your combo kills squishy champions.
  • Three items (Rabadon's Deathcap): with your stacks, you can one-shot almost anyone.

Top tips

  • Last-hit with Q to stack ability power. Two minions with one Q is the goal.
  • Place E so the enemy has to walk through its edge.
  • Drop W on stunned enemies to guarantee it lands.
  • Use R on low-health enemies: it deals more damage the lower they are.
  • Stay far back in fights: Veigar has no dash.
  • Be patient early. Your scaling wins the late game.
